title: Location of Access to the Street
previewText: In addition to the provisions of Sections 25-75, 36-662 and 44-562 (Location of access to the street), no entrance or exit to an accessory off-street loading berth shall be located on a street with a roadbed width that is less than 20 feet, as measured curb to curb.
